```yaml
name: Regression Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regression-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch base branch
        run: |
          echo "Fetching base branch ${{ github.base_ref }}"
          git fetch origin ${{ github.base_ref }}

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Build and test
        run: mvn -B clean compile test

      - name: Detect base-only files
        id: detect_base_only
        run: |
          echo "Detecting base-only files..."
          BASE_BRANCH=${{ github.base_ref }}
          # Files changed between base and current branch
          BASE_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only origin/$BASE_BRANCH...HEAD)
          OURS_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD...origin/$BASE_BRANCH)
          # Base-only: changed in base but not in ours
          BASE_ONLY=$(echo "$BASE_CHANGED" | grep -v -f <(echo "$OURS_CHANGED"))
          echo "Base-only files:"
          echo "$BASE_ONLY"
          echo "base_only_files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$BASE_ONLY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Enforce mandatory answer-session policy
        run: |
          echo "Enforcing mandatory answer-session policy..."
          if [ -z "${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}" ]; then
            echo "No base-only files detected."
          else
            echo "Base-only files detected: ${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}"
            echo "Failing due to mandatory policy: never take ours for base-only files."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Post-rebase regression scan
        run: |
          echo "Running post-rebase regression scan..."
          BASE_BRANCH=${{ github.base_ref }}
          # Verify base-only files match the base branch
          if [ -n "${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r file; do
              if ! git diff --quiet origin/$BASE_BRANCH -- "$file"; then
                echo "Regression detected: $file differs from base branch."
                exit 1
              fi
            done <<< "${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}"
          fi
          # Scan for unintended net deletions
          DELETED=$(git diff --name-status origin/$BASE_BRANCH...HEAD | grep '^D' | awk '{print $2}')
          if [ -n "$DELETED" ]; then
            echo "Unintended deletions detected:"
            echo "$DELETED"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "No regressions detected."
```
